summary: Iteration 5 — Verification of the frontend edit-flow rewrites (Payments/Tasks/PromisesPanel + FormDialog reset-on-open). Backend regression pytest 13/13 green. FormDialog useEffect(open, initial) correctly pre-fills edit dialogs for Payments/Tasks/Promises (verified — amount=350, concept='Prueba pago editable', task title='Tarea de prueba edit', promise amount=200, days=3 all pre-filled). Task detail modal opens on card body click; the 'Editar' button inside detail pre-fills the form. Regression sweep of /panel, /clientes, /pagos, /promesas, /arqueos, /desconectados, /whatsapp, /planes, /extras, /mapa, /olt, /mikrotik, /tareas, /usuarios, /config → 0 pageerrors per route. Mikrotik page now shows ServerInfoPanel (11 copy-* buttons) and the '+ Nuevo Mikrotik' dropdown (both iteration-4 blockers resolved). CRITICAL FINDING: /api/payments HAS NO PATCH ENDPOINT — payment edits (and promise edits, which also PATCH /payments) fail with HTTP 405 'Method Not Allowed'. The frontend Payments.jsx / PromisesPanel.jsx call `api.patch('/payments/{id}', payload)` but backend server.py only defines GET/POST/DELETE for /payments (custom router at lines 877-914), unlike /tasks which uses crud_router and does expose PATCH. Repro: on /pagos, click any edit-payment-<id>, change Monto to 777, Save → toast 'Request failed with status code 405' and DB not updated ($777 does not appear in table). Task edit save works (PATCH /tasks/{id} via crud_router).

critical.issue: Endpoint does not exist → returns 405 Method Not Allowed. Both Payments.jsx edit flow and PromisesPanel.jsx edit flow call this. Add a PATCH handler in server.py alongside the custom /payments GET/POST/DELETE handlers (crud_router is not used for /payments because it needs custom side-effects on create — but PATCH must be added by hand). Must at minimum accept amount/method/concept/notes/promise_date/extension_days/is_promise and set updated_at.

integration_issues.issue: PATCH /payments/{id} → 405, so the 'Editar pago' button in /pagos is functionally broken. Same for /promesas 'Editar promesa' (also PATCHes /payments/{id}).

action_items: Add PATCH /api/payments/{pid} in /app/backend/server.py: fetch payment, apply allowed field updates (amount, method, concept, invoice_number, is_promise, promise_date, extension_days, notes), set updated_at, upsert=False. Return the updated document (exclude _id). Guard with require_roles('owner','admin').
After fix, re-run frontend flow: edit-payment-<id> → change amount → save → verify table shows new amount and toast 'Pago actualizado'. Same on /promesas.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /payments handlers were hand-written (POST has client next_due_date side-effect) so PATCH was omitted. When PATCH is added, decide whether editing amount/is_promise should also re-adjust the client's next_due_date; likely NO (edits shouldn't advance the cycle again).

PromisesPanel.PromiseDialog.submit sends is_promise:true and method:'other' on PATCH — make sure the future PATCH handler does not overwrite fields with unrelated defaults if the client didn't intend to change them.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 pytest, but /payments PATCH is missing altogether — not covered by existing tests)
success_rate.frontend: 88% (edit dialogs pre-fill correctly; task edit save works; payment/promise edit save fails due to backend 405)

seed_data_creation: None new. Existing seed used: payment 'Prueba pago editable' $350 cash, task 'Tarea de prueba edit' backlog, 2 promise-payments.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Focus retest: (1) PATCH /api/payments/{id} exists and updates amount/concept persistently — verify with curl then via UI edit-payment-<id> in /pagos and edit-promise-<id> in /promesas. (2) After payment PATCH, confirm no unintended change to client.next_due_date. Regression pages already 0-error; skip full sweep. FormDialog reset-on-open works, edit-user prefill regression from iteration 4 is now fixed. Mikrotik ServerInfoPanel + Nuevo Mikrotik dropdown mounted.
rca_of_the_issue: Frontend Payments.jsx (line 60) and PromisesPanel.jsx (line 218) were updated to call `api.patch('/payments/{id}', payload)`, but backend /app/backend/server.py defines /payments via hand-written GET/POST/DELETE handlers (lines 877-914) with no @api.patch. Unlike /tasks which uses crud_router (line 408) that ships PATCH, /payments is custom because create needs to update client.next_due_date. A PATCH handler must be added manually. Iteration-4 note 'PATCH /payments already verified via crud_router' is incorrect — /payments does not use crud_router.
